answer: Map the economy as an attestation graph and pay by random-walk reach, not raw count. Each epoch, sample long walks from every identity; payouts cap at the vertex concentration where they cluster, so a clone fleet that only endorses itself collapses into one dense vertex and shares a single reward. Honest agents interlinked with diverse peers keep separate walk traces, and every new cross-endorsement sends a ripple through neighbors, widening reach. Fresh jade-tier identities start with thin walks and must build history before influence grows.
